references.title: A green iris and an almond opening.
study: A golden-brown zone round the pupil runs out along the fibres into yellow-green (central heterochromia).
The dark limbal ring; the crease about 7–8 mm above the lashes.
Measured zones: pupillary #5c624c, middle #7a7e5d, outer #74794d (IRIS_TYPES green).

source.title: File:GreenEye3.jpg
source.credit: https://pixabay.com/photos/eye-iris-look-focus-green-1132531/

references.title: A hazel-green iris and a round opening.

White shows below the iris: a round eye's lower lid curves down.

references.title: A single (mono) lid close up.
study: No crease: the lid is smooth from the brow to the lashes, which point down and show little.
An epicanthal fold covers the inner corner (EYE_SHAPES monolid).

references.title: In-fold double lids.
study: A low crease that starts at the epicanthal fold at the inner corner and runs out to the outer corner (EYE_SHAPES inner-double).
An upward canthal tilt.

references.title: An epicanthal fold over the inner corner.

references.title: Young skin close up under a raking light.
study: Primary furrows crossing in three directions into triangles and rhombi, finer secondary lines between them (SKIN_REGIONS: three primary families, three secondary).
Each plateau is a little domed and catches the light; a fine vellus hair lies along the skin.

source.title: File:Human skin close-up.jpg
source.credit: Pixabay archive copy at the Wayback Machine

references.title: The back of a hand at macro scale.
study: A coarser, deeper network than the face's, crossed by folds over the bones and tendons.
A glossy sheen on the plateaus.

source.title: File:Hand skin closeup.jpg
source.credit: Own work

references.title: Old skin: deep furrows and crêpe.
study: With age the primary furrows deepen and widen while the secondary lines thin out (reported in replica studies): the network becomes coarse cushions.
Larger folds cross the network.

source.title: File:OldSkin.jpg
source.credit: https://www.flickr.com/photos/cogdog/5227755871/

references.title: Freckles across the nose and cheeks.

study: Knuckle folds, raised veins and the crêpe of thin skin over the back of the hand.
